CustomField.description: The answers so far -- the booking form's own field map, or the questionnaire's answer payload, discriminated by Draft_Type__c. Only fields the visitor filled in themselves are ever written here. Field-level access: GTM_Config_Manager (internal reps) and GTM_Story_Guest (its own booking-draft population only, via GtmFormDraftController). GTM_Assessment_Guest is deliberately NOT granted this field, or any field/object permission on GTM_Form_Draft__c at all -- its access to the questionnaire-draft population is entirely through GtmAssessmentDraftController's class grant. See docs/handoff/port-map-ma-to-gtm.md section E.
CustomField.label: Draft
